params.prompt: Photoreal cinematic wide photograph taken standing on the flat concrete roof of a very tall skyscraper at dusk, with a low stone parapet ledge running across the lower part of the frame and a vast modern city skyline of glowing towers far below and behind it. An elegant, majestic night sky with TWO large full moons, one in the upper left and one in the upper right, leaving the centre of the sky clear. The sky is mostly deep indigo and dark navy, with warm amber and soft violet glow low along the horizon, and only a subtle touch of greenish cyan in thin high clouds near the top corners. The centre of the frame behind where a person would stand is NOT green or cyan: it is dark indigo fading to warm amber. No people, no person, no text, no logos, no signs. Shallow depth of field, the city softly out of focus.
